amendments.note: The freeze was not edited and no acceptance criterion changed: at most 160 characters stays an acceptance condition, and the required facts, the frozen regex and the single-line contract prefix are unchanged. What changed is where the structured contract is enforced.

what_changed.before: the agent carried output_type=StructuredAnswer, so the OpenAI Agents SDK enforced the JSON schema provider-side through response_format
what_changed.after: the agent carries no output_type; the model is still asked, in the prompt, for the byte-identical JSON object, and the frozen renderer in experiments/runners/openai_agents_structured_final_v16.py is the final-answer path and the only validator: it parses the JSON, requires exactly the four fields, rejects duplicate keys, missing or extra fields, wrong types and unsafe strings, checks that every declared fact appears in the rendered line, and rejects anything longer than 160 characters. The rendered line replaces the model's JSON as the answer the frozen scoring sees; a rejected proposal is closed to an empty answer. At most one retry is billed, and it is metered.

the frozen renderer module and its hash
the four conditions and the 160-character bound
the single retry budget and the per-call metering
